description: Set up an architecture spike workspace to evaluate Redis vs. in-memory session storage. Create directory 'session_spike/' with 5 files: (1) redis_approach.py - implement a class with set(key,value) and get(key) methods using redis library, (2) memory_approach.py - implement a class with set(key,value) and get(key) methods using Python dict, (3) benchmark.py - import both approaches and include timing logic to compare them, (4) requirements.txt - list 'redis' as dependency, (5) FINDINGS.md - document with sections for Problem, Approaches, Results, and Trade-offs. Configure VSCode: create .vscode/settings.json with Python interpreter path setting (python.defaultInterpreterPath or python.pythonPath), create .vscode/launch.json with debug configuration named 'Run Benchmark' or similar that targets benchmark.py. Track work in Git: make at least 2 commits with messages mentioning 'spike', 'session', 'redis', 'memory', or 'benchmark'. All Python files must have valid syntax.
